newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Air BP, Georgia to set up air fuel supply JV.
newsitem.headline: Air BP, Georgia to set up air fuel supply JV.

text.p: Air British Petroleum (Air BP) and Georgia-based Aviatoplivoservice Ltd on Friday announced that they have set up a joint venture to supply Tbilisi airport with fuel.
"We have set up the venture in Georgia seeing a big potential to supply transport links here," Air BP president Ralph Alexander told a news conference on Friday.
He said his company planned to invest $3 million in the venture named GFS by the end of this year. Aviatoplivoservice will contribute the same value in equipment.

Alexander said that fuel would be carried to Tbilisi's airport from Azerbaijan by railroad and from Europe by sea. Air BP also planned to supply fuel supply equipment for the Tbilisi airport, he said.
Alexander told Reuters that in future it would be possible for the joint venture to sell fuel from Caspian Sea oil drilled by British Petroleum.
Air BP supplies fuel for 1,200 airports around the world.
